umf.visual.title: Level 3: Component Diagram
umf.visual.question: How is the API Service's import path built?

nodes.label: Upload Controller
nodes.detail:
Purpose: Receives bank and invoice CSV uploads for one client import session

Notes: Rejects non-CSV files before parsing

nodes.label: Mapping Service
nodes.detail:
Purpose: Saves and applies per-client column mappings

Notes: Never imports rows with unresolved required mappings

nodes.label: CSV Validation Service
nodes.detail:
Purpose: Validates amounts, dates, identifiers, duplicates, and required columns

Notes: Produces row-level rejection reasons

nodes.label: Import Commit Service
nodes.detail:
Purpose: Atomically records accepted source rows and traceability fields

Notes: Transaction boundary for import confirmation

nodes.label: Evidence Service
nodes.detail:
Purpose: Supplies source-row evidence to match review, exceptions, and exports

Notes: Reads normalized fields and source metadata

umf.visual.takeaway: The API Service needs component detail because CSV import, traceability, and matching are coupled at the boundary.
